instructions:
1. Attach a single kettlebell to a low sled or drag harness.
2. Place both hands on the sled posts or grip the kettlebell handle low.
3. Lean forward with straight arms and a flat back, core braced.
4. Drive through the balls of your feet and push the sled forward in short powerful strides.
5. Keep moving for the set distance or time.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and core tight so you do not feel it in the lower back.
2. Stay low and lean into the push for more quad and glute drive.
3. Take short, fast steps and push through the front of each foot.
4. Keep your arms straight to transfer force efficiently.
name: Single Kettlebell Sled Push

instructions:
1. Attach a rope to a loaded sled and sit or stand facing it.
2. Grip the rope with both hands and brace your core.
3. Pull the rope toward you hand over hand, driving your elbows back.
4. Engage your lats and squeeze your shoulder blades on each pull.
5. Continue until the sled reaches you or for the set time.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead each pull with your elbows to load the lats, not just the arms.
2. Use a firm but relaxed grip so your forearms last longer.
3. Keep your core braced and back flat throughout.
4. Drive through your legs if standing to move heavier loads.
name: Sled Battle Rope Pull

instructions:
1. Attach handles or a rope to a loaded sled and grip them.
2. Step back into a slight lunge with a flat back and braced core.
3. Drive through your legs to drag the sled while stepping backward.
4. At each step, row the handles to your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
5. Continue dragging and rowing for the set distance or time.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pull the handles to your ribs, leading with the elbows for back engagement.
2. Keep your chest up and back flat as you drag.
3. Drive through your heels on the lower-body portion.
4. Brace your core to stay stable against the load.
name: Sled Drag and Row

instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor and extend one leg straight forward, heel down.
2. Slide the front foot forward and the back leg straight behind you.
3. Lower your hips toward the floor as far as flexibility allows.
4. Keep your torso upright and place your hands on the floor or blocks for support.
5. Hold the position and breathe steadily for the set time.
6. Switch legs and repeat.
tips:
1. Warm up the hamstrings and hips before attempting the full split.
2. Use blocks under your hands to control depth and protect the hamstrings.
3. Keep your hips square and facing forward.
4. Ease out slowly and stop if you feel sharp pain in the groin or hamstring.
name: Monkey Pose

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body straight.
2. Brace your core and keep your hips level.
3. Jump both feet forward toward your chest at the same time.
4. Jump your feet back to the plank position.
5. Continue jumping in and out at a steady pace.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag or pike.
2. Land softly on the balls of your feet to protect your knees.
3. Keep your shoulders stacked over your wrists.
4. Breathe rhythmically and keep a controlled tempo.
name: Mountain Climber Jumps
